Add client onboarding workflow definition

Documentation-style YAML capturing the new client onboarding process
(intake, contract, provisioning, kickoff) with best-judgment defaults
for trigger, owners, and SLAs. Kept in draft status until business
requirements are confirmed; reshaping needed if an automation tool
will consume it later.
